_instructions: Prima Materia digest: a semantic graph of ONE subject, written once from the full source text.
nodes: people, places, objects, fears, obsessions, themes and traits that matter to the subject.
edges: how two nodes relate ('loves', 'fears', 'lives in', 'distrusts'), from the subject's point of view where possible.
evidence: 1-3 SHORT verbatim quotes (one sentence or less) with a location. Copy them exactly: every quote is checked against the source, and quotes the text does not contain are reported.
voice_samples: 5-10 short lines of the subject's own speech or inner voice, verbatim.
Keep quotes short and few: this is a map with landmarks, not a copy of the text.
Save it with save_prima_digest(digest). Later creation runs read it with fetch_prima_digest().
subject: Mara Quell
source: Title and author of the source text
